issues.description: generate-stories cannot bootstrap a missing dataset because it requires data/stories/manifest.json before generation.
Default pipeline points at data/stories, but the repository contains zero story files, so extraction/demo runs are not reproducible.
Advertised tiny integration test runs the full pipeline but will fail from a clean repo because required story data is absent.
load_vectors trusts stale artifacts without validating model, scale, emotions, layer count, d_model, or array shapes against the current run.
Validation blindly indexes projected vectors from the manifest, so mismatched or corrupt artifacts can produce silent wrong results.
Steering blindly trusts manifest steer_layers and mean_resid_norms without checking they match the loaded model or vector tensor.
Steering integration test only checks that scores move, not that movement matches the claimed correlation/direction.
Checked-in steering summary contradicts the claimed correlation-vs-shift relationship, including negative overall correlation and wrong-signed shifts.
parse_story_block treats any preamble before the first <NEW STORY> delimiter as a story, corrupting generated datasets.
Story generation HTTP call has no timeout, so a stalled endpoint can hang the command indefinitely.
mean_activations can divide by zero for one-token inputs because effective_start can equal sequence length.
pca_components divides by total variance without guarding zero-variance inputs, producing NaN components.
load_stories ignores manifest contents and performs no completeness/quality validation before extraction.
Story dataset test is skipped when the dataset is missing, masking the repo's main reproducibility failure.
Generated egg-info and outputs are present in the repo/worktree despite being ignored, creating cleanup and provenance ambiguity.
Dev tooling only declares pytest; there is no linting, formatting, type checking, or reproducible dependency lock for active development.
